title: Assess observed effects of an adopted engineering improvement
description: Compare observations of an adopted improvement with its success and adverse-effect criteria, keeping triggering reproduction separate from later comparable use and reassessing conclusions when the context changes. Assurance behaviors own the underlying evidence and applicable judgments.
inputs: Adopted improvement, its triggering mechanism, applicability conditions, and assessment criteria.
Triggering-situation observations when reproducible and observations from later comparable work.
Recorded recurrence, confusion or burden, and material context changes.
preconditions: The improvement version and assessment context are identifiable, or the assessment remains incomplete.
outputs: Context-bounded observations of recurrence, intended behavior, and adverse effects.
Effectiveness assessment or explicit unassessed/reassessment-needed state with its reasons.
behavior: Assess the triggering situation when reproducible and report nonreproducibility otherwise.
Identify the next comparable activity after adoption and assess the recorded intended behavior, recurrence, and adverse effects.
Leave effectiveness unassessed when no comparable activity has occurred, regardless of adoption or a successful triggering reproduction.
Preserve contradictory and incomplete observations and restrict conclusions to observed contexts.
On recurrence or material context change, require a fresh applicable assessment without rewriting the previous observation or bounded conclusion.

failure_behavior.condition: No comparable opportunity or insufficient observations are available.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report effectiveness unassessed and identify the missing basis; elapsed time is not substituted for evidence.

failure_behavior.condition: The context differs materially or observations conflict.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the limit or contradiction and request reassessment rather than asserting continued effectiveness.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: SR-038 defines the opportunity-based improvement assessment and reassessment behavior; IR-004 owns evidence applicability and judgment.
